description: Technical University of Munich publishes TUM-FAÇADE, a benchmark of mobile laser-scanning point clouds with facade-level labels such as windows, doors, balconies and mouldings. Registered version 3 metadata reports 33 annotated facades, eight unannotated facades and approximately 333 million annotated points for the TUM Campus area. Training and test folders are combined into one point-cloud folder, and earlier unlabelled buildings receive additional annotations. The documentation supplies local and global coordinates and links filenames to official Bavarian CityGML building identifiers. This supports detailed building reconstruction within the TUM2TWIN digital twin. The selected homepage and DOI identify version 3; the repository's older citation to version 1 is preserved as a distinct version reference. Descriptive access is free, but dataset-specific licence and storage access conditions were not established. File formats and acquisition dates remain uncertain. Caveats include the 45.66-metre height-offset guidance and remaining unannotated facades. ZAHA is a related, separate benchmark. No point clouds, storage listing or code file was retrieved.
